units.zh: 列傳一百五十一
units.en: Biography 151
units.literal: Biographies 151

units.zh: 阮元汪廷珍湯金釗
units.en: Ruan Yuan, Wang Tingzhen, and Tang Jinzhao
units.literal: Ruan Yuan, Wang Tingzhen, Tang Jinzhao

units.zh: 阮元，字伯元，江蘇儀徵人。
units.en: Ruan Yuan, courtesy name Boyuan, came from Yizheng in Jiangsu.
units.literal: Ruan Yuan, styled Boyuan, was a native of Yizheng in Jiangsu.

units.zh: 祖玉堂，官湖南參將，從征苗，活降苗數千人，有陰德。
units.en: His grandfather Yu Tang had been a Hunan deputy commander; on campaigns against the Miao he had spared several thousand who surrendered, accumulating hidden merit.
units.literal: His grandfather Yu Tang served as deputy commander in Hunan; campaigning against the Miao, he spared the lives of several thousand surrendered Miao — a hidden virtue.

units.zh: 元，乾隆五十四年進士，選庶吉士，散館第一，授編修。
units.en: In Qianlong 54 he became a jinshi, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, placed first when leaving the academy, and received appointment as compiler.
units.literal: Yuan passed the jinshi examination in the fifty-fourth year of Qianlong, was selected a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, ranked first upon leaving the academy, and was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 逾年大考，高宗親擢第一，超擢少詹事。
units.en: The following year, in the palace examination, the Gaozong Emperor personally placed him first and exceptionally promoted him to junior vice-president of the Secretariat.
units.literal: The next year in the great examination the Gaozong Emperor personally ranked him first and promoted him in exceptional fashion to junior vice-president of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 召對，上喜曰：「不意朕八旬外復得一人！」
units.en: When summoned for audience, the emperor said with delight, "I never thought that after my eightieth year I should gain another man like this!"
units.literal: Summoned for audience, the emperor said with pleasure: "I did not expect that beyond my eightieth year I should gain another such man!"

units.zh: 直南書房、懋勤殿，遷詹事。
units.en: He was assigned to the Southern Study and Maqin Hall, and was promoted to supervisor of the Heir Apparent’s Household.
units.literal: He served in the Southern Study and the Maqin Hall, and was transferred to supervisor of the Heir Apparent’s Household.

units.zh: 五十八年，督山東學政，任滿，調浙江。
units.en: In year 58 he served as educational commissioner of Shandong; when his term ended he was moved to Zhejiang.
units.literal: In the fifty-eighth year he supervised education in Shandong; when his term ended he was transferred to Zhejiang.

units.zh: 歷兵部、禮部、戶部侍郎。
units.en: He served in succession as vice-minister of War, Rites, and Revenue.
units.literal: He successively held the posts of vice-minister of War, of Rites, and of Revenue.

units.zh: 嘉慶四年，署浙江巡撫，尋實授。
units.en: In Jiaqing 4 he acted as Zhejiang governor and soon received the substantive post.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he acted as governor of Zhejiang and soon received substantive appointment.

units.zh: 海寇擾浙歷數年，安南夷艇最強，鳳尾、水澳、箬黃諸幫附之，沿海土匪勾結為患。
units.en: Pirates had harassed Zhejiang for years; Annamese junks were the strongest, with the Fengwei, Shui'ao, Ruohuang, and other gangs in their train, while coastal bandits colluded to spread the disorder.
units.literal: Sea bandits had troubled Zhejiang for several years; Annamese foreign boats were strongest, and the Fengwei, Shui'ao, Ruohuang, and other gangs attached themselves to them, while coastal bandits colluded to make trouble.

units.zh: 元徵集群議為弭盜之策，造船砲，練陸師，杜接濟。
units.en: Yuan gathered officials to plan suppression of piracy—building warships and guns, training land troops, and blocking resupply.
units.literal: Yuan convened a council to devise measures to suppress piracy: building ships and cannon, drilling land forces, and cutting off supplies.

units.zh: 五年春，令黃岩鎮總兵岳璽擊箬黃幫，滅之。
units.en: In spring of year 5 he ordered Huangyan commander Yue Xi to strike the Ruohuang gang and annihilate it.
units.literal: In the spring of the fifth year he ordered Yue Xi, commanding general at Huangyan, to attack the Ruohuang gang and destroy it.

units.zh: 夏，寇大至，元赴台州督剿，請以定海鎮總兵李長庚總統三鎮水師，並調粵、閩兵會剿。
units.en: That summer the raiders came in strength; Yuan went to Taizhou to direct the campaign, asked that Dinghai commander Li Changgeng command all three fleets, and mobilized Guangdong and Fujian forces for a joint campaign.
units.literal: In summer the bandits came in force; Yuan went to Taizhou to supervise suppression, requested that Li Changgeng, commanding general at Dinghai, take overall command of the three naval commands, and also called in troops from Guangdong and Fujian for joint operations.

units.zh: 六月，夷艇糾鳳尾、水澳等賊共百餘艘，屯松門山下。
units.en: In the sixth month the foreign junks gathered Fengwei, Shui'ao, and other pirates in more than a hundred vessels and anchored below Songmen Mountain.
units.literal: In the sixth month foreign boats mustered Fengwei, Shui'ao, and other bandits in more than a hundred vessels and encamped below Songmen Mountain.

units.zh: 遣諜間水澳賊先退，會颶風大作，盜艇覆溺無算，餘眾登山，檄陸師搜捕，擒八百餘人。
units.en: He used agents to set the Shui'ao pirates retreating first; a typhoon then struck, drowning countless pirate craft; the survivors fled ashore, and he ordered land forces to hunt them down, capturing more than eight hundred.
units.literal: He sent spies to sow discord so the Shui'ao bandits withdrew first; a great typhoon then arose, and countless pirate boats capsized and were drowned; the remainder went ashore, and he ordered land forces to search and capture more than eight hundred men.

units.zh: 安南四總兵溺斃者三，黃岩知縣孫鳳鳴獲其一，曰倫貴利，磔之。
units.en: Three of four Annamese commanders drowned; Huangyan magistrate Sun Fengming seized one named Lun Guili and had him torn apart.
units.literal: Of four Annamese commanding generals three drowned; Sun Fengming, magistrate of Huangyan, captured one named Lun Guili and had him dismembered.

units.zh: 九月，總兵岳璽、胡振聲會擊水澳幫，擒殲殆盡。
units.en: In the ninth month commanders Yue Xi and Hu Zhensheng jointly attacked the Shui'ao gang and nearly wiped it out.
units.literal: In the ninth month commanders Yue Xi and Hu Zhensheng jointly attacked the Shui'ao gang and captured or killed nearly all of them.

units.zh: 土匪亦次第殲撫。
units.en: Land bandits were likewise suppressed or pacified in turn.
units.literal: Land bandits were also successively exterminated or pacified.

units.zh: 浙洋漸清，而餘盜為蔡牽所並，閩師不能制，勢益熾，复時犯浙。
units.en: Zhejiang waters grew calmer, but remnants were absorbed by Cai Qian; Fujian troops could not contain him, his power swelled, and he again raided Zhejiang.
units.literal: The Zhejiang seas gradually grew calm, but remaining bandits were absorbed by Cai Qian; Fujian forces could not control them, their power grew fiercer, and they again raided Zhejiang from time to time.

units.zh: 李長庚巳擢提督，元集貲與造霆船成，配巨砲，數破牽於海上。
units.en: Li Changgeng had been promoted to provincial commander; Yuan raised funds to build "thunder" warships with heavy guns and repeatedly defeated Qian at sea.
units.literal: Li Changgeng had already been promoted to provincial commander-in-chief; Yuan raised funds and built thunder ships fitted with great cannon, repeatedly defeating Qian at sea.

units.zh: 八年，奏建昭忠祠，以歷年捕海盜傷亡將士從祀。
units.en: In year 8 he memorialized to build the Zhaozhong Shrine for officers and men killed in years of anti-pirate fighting.
units.literal: In the eighth year he memorialized to build the Zhaozhong Shrine to enshrine officers and men killed fighting pirates over the years.

units.zh: 盜首黃葵集舟數十，號新興幫，令總兵岳璽、張成等追剿，逾年乃平之。
units.en: Bandit leader Huang Kui gathered dozens of vessels as the Xinxing gang; Yuan ordered commanders Yue Xi and Zhang Cheng to pursue them, and peace came only after more than a year.
units.literal: The bandit chief Huang Kui gathered several dozen boats under the name Xinxing gang; Yuan ordered commanders Yue Xi and Zhang Cheng to pursue them, and only after more than a year were they pacified.

units.zh: 偕總督玉德奏請以李長庚總督兩省水師，數逐蔡牽幾獲，而玉德遇事仍掣肘。
units.en: With Governor Yu De he asked that Li Changgeng command both provinces' fleets; Li several times nearly took Cai Qian, but Yu De still obstructed him.
units.literal: Together with Governor Yu De he memorialized that Li Changgeng be made overall commander of the two provinces' naval forces; he several times nearly captured Cai Qian, but Yu De still hampered him at every turn.

units.zh: 十年，元丁父憂去職，長庚益無助，復與總督阿林保不協，久無成功，遂戰歿。
units.en: In year 10 Yuan left on mourning for his father; Changgeng lacked backing, quarreled again with Governor Alinbao, made no headway for long, and finally fell in battle.
units.literal: In the tenth year Yuan left office on mourning for his father; Changgeng lacked support all the more, again fell out with Governor Alinbao, achieved nothing for a long time, and finally died in battle.

units.zh: 十一年，詔起元署福建巡撫，以病辭。
units.en: In year 11 an edict recalled him to act as Fujian governor; he declined because of illness.
units.literal: In the eleventh year an edict recalled Yuan to act as Fujian governor; he declined on grounds of illness.

units.zh: 十二年，服闋，署戶部侍郎，赴河南按事。
units.en: In year 12, when mourning ended, he acted as vice-minister of Revenue and went to Henan on an investigative mission.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, when mourning ended, he acted as vice-minister of Revenue and went to Henan on an inspection.

units.zh: 授兵部侍郎，復命為浙江巡撫，暫署河南巡撫。
units.en: He was appointed vice-minister of War, again ordered to Zhejiang as governor, and temporarily acted as Henan governor.
units.literal: He was appointed vice-minister of War, again ordered to be Zhejiang governor, and temporarily acted as Henan governor.

units.zh: 十三年，乃至浙，詔責其防海殄寇。
units.en: In year 13 he finally reached Zhejiang; an edict rebuked him to guard the coast and destroy the pirates.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he finally reached Zhejiang; an edict rebuked him to defend the coast and exterminate the bandits.

units.zh: 秋，蔡牽、硃濆合犯定海，親駐寧波督三鎮擊走之，牽复遁閩洋。
units.en: That autumn Cai Qian and Zhu Fen jointly attacked Dinghai; he personally stationed at Ningbo to direct the three commands in driving them off, and Qian fled again to Fujian waters.
units.literal: In autumn Cai Qian and Zhu Fen jointly attacked Dinghai; he personally stationed at Ningbo to direct the three commands in driving them off, and Qian again fled to Fujian waters.

units.zh: 時用長庚部將王得祿、邱良功為兩省提督，協力勦賊，元議海戰分兵隔賊船之策，專攻蔡牽。
units.en: Wang Delu and Qiu Lianggong, former subordinates of Changgeng, were made commanders of the two provinces and cooperated against the pirates; Yuan urged dividing forces at sea to cut off enemy ships and focus on Cai Qian.
units.literal: At that time Li Changgeng's former subordinates Wang Delu and Qiu Lianggong were made provincial commanders of the two provinces; they cooperated in suppressing bandits; Yuan proposed the strategy of dividing forces at sea to interpose between enemy ships, concentrating on Cai Qian.

units.zh: 十四年秋，合擊​​於漁山外洋，竟殄牽，詳得祿等傳。
units.en: In autumn of year 14 they united in battle off Yushan in the open sea and finally destroyed Qian; details appear in the biographies of Delu and others.
units.literal: In the autumn of the fourteenth year they joined battle off Yushan in the outer seas and finally destroyed Qian; details are in the biographies of Delu and others.

units.zh: 元兩治浙，多惠政，平寇功尤著雲。
units.en: Yuan governed Zhejiang twice with many benevolent measures, and his success in pacifying pirates was especially notable.
units.literal: Yuan governed Zhejiang twice, enacted many benevolent policies, and his merit in pacifying bandits was especially outstanding.

units.zh: 方督師寧波時，奏請學政劉鳳誥代辦鄉試監臨，有聯號弊，為言官論劾，遣使鞫實，詔斥徇庇，褫職，予編修，在文穎館行走。
units.en: While commanding at Ningbo he asked educational commissioner Liu Fenggao to supervise the provincial exams in his place; linked examination numbers were exposed; censors impeached him; an investigator confirmed it; an edict rebuked his favoritism, stripped his rank, and gave him compiler duty in the Wenyin Hall.
units.literal: While directing troops at Ningbo he memorialized that educational commissioner Liu Fenggao supervise the provincial examination in his stead; linked examination numbers were discovered; censors impeached him; an envoy investigated and confirmed the facts; an edict rebuked him for favoritism, stripped his post, and gave him compiler rank with duty in the Wenyin Hall.

units.zh: 累遷內閣學士。
units.en: He was promoted in succession to academician of the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to academician of the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 命赴山西、河南按事，遷工部侍郎，出為漕運總督。
units.en: Ordered to inspect Shanxi and Henan, he was moved to vice-minister of Works and then appointed director-general of grain transport.
units.literal: Ordered to Henan and Shanxi on inspection, he was transferred to vice-minister of Works and then sent out as director-general of grain transport.

units.zh: 十九年，調江西巡撫。
units.en: In year 19 he was transferred to governor of Jiangxi.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year he was transferred to Jiangxi as governor.

units.zh: 以捕治逆匪胡秉耀，加太子少保，賜花翎。
units.en: For capturing the rebel Hu Bingyao he was made junior guardian of the heir apparent and granted peacock feathers.
units.literal: For capturing and punishing the rebel Hu Bingyao he was given the rank of junior guardian of the heir apparent and bestowed peacock feathers.

units.zh: 二十一年，調河南，擢湖廣總督。
units.en: In year 21 he was transferred to Henan and promoted to governor-general of Huguang.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year he was transferred to Henan and promoted to governor-general of Huguang.

units.zh: 修武昌江堤，建江陵范家堤、沔陽龍王廟石閘。
units.en: He repaired the Wuchang river dike and built the Fan family dike at Jiangling and the stone sluice at the Dragon King Temple in Mianyang.
units.literal: He repaired the Wuchang river embankment and built the Fan family embankment at Jiangling and the stone sluice at the Dragon King Temple in Mianyang.

units.zh: 二十二年，調兩廣總督。
units.en: In year 22 he was transferred to governor-general of the Two Guangs.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to governor-general of Liangguang.

units.zh: 先一年，英吉利貢使入京，未成禮而回，遂漸跋扈。
units.en: The year before, an English tribute mission had entered the capital and returned without completing the rites, after which they grew increasingly arrogant.
units.literal: The year before, an English tribute mission had entered the capital, left without completing the rites, and thereafter grew increasingly overbearing.

units.zh: 元增建大黃滘、大虎山兩砲台，分兵駐守。
units.en: Yuan additionally built batteries at Dahuangjiao and Dahu Mountain and stationed troops in detachments.
units.literal: Yuan additionally built two batteries at Dahuangjiao and Dahu Mountain and stationed troops in detachments.

units.zh: 迭疏陳預防夷患，略曰：「英吉利恃強桀驁，性復貪利。
units.en: In repeated memorials on guarding against foreign trouble he wrote in summary: "England relies on force and is fierce and overbearing, and by nature greedy for gain.
units.literal: In repeated memorials he set forth measures to guard against foreign trouble, saying in summary: "England relies on strength and is fierce and arrogant, and by nature is also greedy for profit.

units.zh: 宜鎮以威，不可盡以德綏。
units.en: They should be restrained by awe; one cannot wholly win them by kindness alone.
units.literal: One should restrain them with awe; one cannot wholly pacify them with virtue alone.

units.zh: 彼之船堅砲利，技長於水短於陸。
units.en: Their ships are strong and their guns effective; they are skilled on water and weak on land.
units.literal: Their ships are stout and their cannon sharp; they excel on water and are weak on land.

units.zh: 定例外國貨船不許擅入內洋，儻違例禁，即宜隨機應變，量加懲創。
units.en: Regulations forbid foreign merchant ships to enter inner waters without permission; if they break the rule, one should adapt to circumstances and punish them proportionally.
units.literal: Regulations fix that foreign merchant vessels may not enter the inner seas without permission; if they violate the prohibition, one should respond flexibly as circumstances require and punish them in due measure.

units.zh: 各國知彼犯我禁，非我輕啟釁也。」
units.en: Other nations will see that they broke our rules and that we did not lightly pick a quarrel."
units.literal: Other nations will see that they violated our prohibition and that we did not lightly begin hostilities."

units.zh: 詔勗以德威相濟，勿孟浪，勿葸懦。
units.en: An edict urged him to combine kindness and severity, neither to be rash nor timid.
units.literal: An edict exhorted him to balance virtue and awe, neither to be rash nor timid.

units.zh: 道光元年，兼署粵海關監督。
units.en: In Daoguang 1 he also acted as superintendent of the Guangdong customs.
units.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he also acted as superintendent of the Guangdong maritime customs.

units.zh: 洋船夾帶鴉片煙，劾褫行商頂帶。
units.en: Foreign ships smuggled opium; he impeached the licensed merchants and stripped their rank.
units.literal: Foreign ships smuggled opium; he impeached and stripped the rank of the licensed merchants.

units.zh: 二年，英吉利護貨兵船泊伶丁外洋，與民鬥，互有傷斃，嚴飭交犯，英人揚言罷市歸國，即停其貿易。
units.en: In year 2 English convoy warships anchored off outer Lingding, fought with locals with casualties on both sides; he sternly demanded the culprits; the English threatened to quit trade and go home, and he at once stopped their trade.
units.literal: In the second year English convoy warships anchored off Lingding in the outer seas, fought with civilians, and both sides suffered casualties; he sternly ordered the culprits handed over; the English threatened to quit trade and return home, and he immediately suspended their trade.

units.zh: 久之拆閱多，託言兵船已歸，俟復來如命。
units.en: After a long interval, with many dispatches examined, they claimed the warships had left and would return when ordered.
units.literal: After a long time, with many letters opened, they claimed the warships had returned and would come again as ordered.

units.zh: 乃暫許貿易，與約船來不交犯乃停止。
units.en: He then temporarily allowed trade, on condition that if ships came without surrendering the culprits trade would stop.
units.literal: He then temporarily permitted trade, agreeing that if ships came without handing over the culprits trade would cease.

units.zh: 終元任，兵船不至。
units.en: Throughout Yuan's term the warships never returned.
units.literal: Throughout Yuan's tenure the warships did not return.

units.zh: 元在粵九年，兼署巡撫凡六次。
units.en: Yuan spent nine years in Guangdong and acted as governor six times in all.
units.literal: Yuan spent nine years in Guangdong and acted as governor six times in all.

units.zh: 六年，調雲貴總督。
units.en: In year 6 he was transferred to governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
units.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

units.zh: 滇鹽久敝，歲絀課十餘萬，元劾罷蠹吏，力杜漏私；
units.en: Yunnan salt had long been corrupt, with annual tax shortfalls exceeding a hundred thousand taels; Yuan impeached corrupt officials and worked to stop smuggling;
units.literal: Yunnan salt had long been corrupt, with annual shortfalls of more than a hundred thousand taels in tax; Yuan impeached and dismissed corrupt officials and strove to stop leakage and private trade;

units.zh: 鹽井衰旺不齊，調劑抵補，逾年課有溢銷，酌撥邊用。
units.en: As well productivity varied, he adjusted accounts; after more than a year receipts exceeded quota, and he allocated the surplus to frontier needs.
units.literal: Salt wells varied in productivity; he adjusted and offset accounts, and after more than a year tax receipts exceeded quotas, and he allocated the surplus for frontier expenses.

units.zh: 騰越邊外野人時入內地劫掠，而保山等處邊夷曰枲僳，以墾山射獵為生，可用，乃募枲僳三百戶屯種山地，以御野人，即以溢課充費，歲有擴充。
units.en: Wild tribes beyond Tengyue sometimes raided inland; border tribes called Xilu around Baoshan lived by farming and hunting and could be used; he recruited three hundred Xilu households to farm uplands against the wild tribes, funding it from surplus salt revenue, with yearly expansion.
units.literal: Wild tribes beyond Tengyue sometimes raided inland, while border tribes called Xilu in Baoshan and elsewhere lived by clearing mountains and hunting and could be employed; he therefore recruited three hundred Xilu households to farm mountain land to repel the wild tribes, using the surplus tax for expenses, with yearly expansion.

units.zh: 野人畏威，漸有降附者。
units.en: The wild tribes feared his power, and some gradually submitted.
units.literal: The wild tribes feared his authority, and some gradually surrendered.

units.zh: 十二年，協辦大學士，仍留總督任。
units.en: In year 12 he was made assistant grand secretary while remaining governor-general.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he was made assistant grand secretary while retaining his post as governor-general.

units.zh: 車里土司刀繩武與叔太康爭鬥，脅官求助，檄鎮道擊走之，另擇承襲乃安。
units.en: Cheli chieftain Dao Shengwu fought his uncle Taikang and pressured officials for aid; Yuan ordered commanders to drive them off and chose another successor, restoring order.
units.literal: Cheli native official Dao Shengwu fought his uncle Taikang; he coerced officials to seek help; Yuan ordered regional commanders to drive them off and chose another heir, restoring peace.

units.zh: 越南保樂州土官農文云內閧，嚴邊防勿使竄入，亦不越境生事，尋文云走死。
units.en: Vietnamese Baole chieftain Nong Wenyun had internal strife; Yuan guarded the border so he would not flee in but did not cross to interfere; soon Wenyun fled and died.
units.literal: Nong Wenyun, native official of Baole prefecture in Vietnam, had internal strife; Yuan strictly guarded the frontier so he would not flee in, yet did not cross the border to make trouble; soon Wenyun fled and died.

units.zh: 詔嘉其鎮靜得大體。
units.en: An edict praised his calm grasp of the larger situation.
units.literal: An edict praised his calm grasp of the larger situation.

units.zh: 十五年，召拜體仁閣大學士，管理刑部，調兵部。
units.en: In year 15 he was summoned as grand secretary of the Tiren Hall, directing the Ministry of Punishments, then moved to War.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year he was summoned and appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall, directing the Ministry of Punishments, then transferred to the Ministry of War.

units.zh: 十八年，以老病請致仕，許之，給半俸，瀕行，加太子太保。
units.en: In year 18 he asked to retire for age and illness; permission was granted with half pay, and on departure he was made senior guardian of the heir apparent.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year he asked to retire on account of age and illness; permission was granted, half salary was given, and on the eve of departure he was made senior guardian of the heir apparent.

units.zh: 二十六年，鄉舉重逢，晉太傅，與鹿鳴宴。
units.en: In year 26 he again celebrated the provincial exam anniversary, was promoted to grand tutor, and attended the deer-ming banquet.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he again met the provincial examination anniversary, was promoted to grand tutor, and attended the deer-ming banquet.

units.zh: 二十九年，卒，年八十有六，優詔賜卹，諡文達。
units.en: In year 29 he died at eighty-six; an edict granted favorable burial rites, with posthumous title Wendà.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he died at eighty-six; an edict of favor granted posthumous rites, and he was given the posthumous title Wendà.

units.zh: 入祀鄉賢祠、浙江名宦祠。
units.en: He was enshrined in the local worthies hall and the Zhejiang hall of eminent officials.
units.literal: He was entered in the local worthies shrine and the Zhejiang shrine of eminent officials.

units.zh: 元博學淹通，早被知遇。
units.en: Yuan was erudite and versatile and early won imperial favor.
units.literal: Yuan was broadly learned and thoroughly versed, and early won imperial favor.

units.zh: 敕編石渠寶笈，校勘石經。
units.en: He was ordered to compile the Shiqu baoji and collate the stone classics.
units.literal: He was ordered to compile the Shiqu baoji and collate the stone classics.

units.zh: 再入翰林，創編國史儒林、文苑傳，至為浙江巡撫，始手成之。
units.en: Re-entering the Hanlin, he began the Ruilin and Wenyuan sections of the national history; only as Zhejiang governor did he finish them himself.
units.literal: Re-entering the Hanlin, he initiated compilation of the Ruilin and Wenyuan sections of the national history; only when he became Zhejiang governor did he personally complete them.

units.zh: 集四庫未收書一百七十二種，撰提要進禦，補中秘之闕。
units.en: He gathered 172 works omitted from the Siku Library, wrote synopses, and presented them to the throne, filling gaps in the imperial collection.
units.literal: He collected 172 works not included in the Siku Library, wrote synopses, and presented them to the throne, filling gaps in the imperial collection.

units.zh: 嘉慶四年，偕大學士硃珪典會試，一時樸學高才搜羅殆盡。
units.en: In Jiaqing 4, with Grand Secretary Zhu Gui he presided over the metropolitan exams and gathered nearly all leading evidential scholars of the day.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, together with Grand Secretary Zhu Gui he presided over the metropolitan examination and gathered nearly all the outstanding scholars of evidential learning of the day.

units.zh: 道光十三年，由雲南入覲，特命典試，時稱異數。
units.en: In Daoguang 13, coming from Yunnan to audience, he was specially ordered to preside over the exams — then called an unprecedented honor.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year of Daoguang, coming from Yunnan to audience, he was specially ordered to preside over the examination — an honor then called unprecedented.

units.zh: 與大學士曹振鏞共事意不合，元歉然。
units.en: Working with Grand Secretary Cao Zhenyong, he found their views did not align, and Yuan felt regret.
units.literal: He did not agree in mind with Grand Secretary Cao Zhenyong when they worked together, and Yuan felt regret.

units.zh: 以前次得人之盛不可復繼，歷官所至，振興文教。
units.en: Knowing such excellence could not be repeated, wherever he served he promoted literary and educational culture.
units.literal: Because the excellence of his earlier selections could not be repeated, wherever he served he promoted literary and educational culture.

units.zh: 在浙江立詁經精舍，祀許慎、鄭康成，選高才肄業；
units.en: In Zhejiang he founded the Gujing Academy, honoring Xu Shen and Zheng Xuan, and selected gifted students to study there;
units.literal: In Zhejiang he founded the Gujing Academy, enshrining Xu Shen and Zheng Xuan, and selected talented students to study there;

units.zh: 在粵立學海堂亦如之，並延攬通儒：造士有家法，人才蔚起。
units.en: In Guangdong he founded the Xuehai Hall likewise, recruited leading scholars, trained students by sound methods, and talent flourished.
units.literal: In Guangdong he founded the Xuehai Hall likewise, and also recruited eminent scholars: training students had a proper method, and talent flourished.

units.zh: 撰十三經校勘記、經籍篡詁、皇清經解百八十餘種，專宗漢學，治經者奉為科律。
units.en: He wrote Collation Notes on the Thirteen Classics, the Jingji cuangu, and more than 180 Qing commentaries, devoted to Han Learning, which classicists treated as canon.
units.literal: He wrote the Collation Notes on the Thirteen Classics, the Jingji cuangu, and more than 180 works of Qing commentaries on the classics, devoted to Han Learning; students of the classics took them as standard.

units.zh: 集清代天文、律算諸家作疇人傳，以章絕學。
units.en: He compiled Biographies of Calculators from Qing astronomers and mathematicians to honor supreme learning.
units.literal: He collected Qing writers on astronomy and mathematics in the Biographies of Calculators to display supreme learning.

units.zh: 重修浙江通志、廣東通志，編輯山左金石志、兩浙金石志、積古齋鐘鼎款識、兩浙輶軒錄、淮海英靈集，刊當代名宿著述數十家為文選樓叢書。
units.en: He revised the Zhejiang and Guangdong gazetteers, compiled Shandong and Zhejiang epigraphic gazetteers, Jigu zhai inscriptions, the Liang-Zhe imperial procession record, the Huaihai anthology, and published dozens of contemporary masters as the Wenxuan lou congshu.
units.literal: He revised the Zhejiang and Guangdong provincial gazetteers, compiled gazetteers of Shandong and Zhejiang inscriptions, the Jigu zhai bell and vessel inscriptions, the Liang-Zhe imperial procession record, the Huaihai anthology, and published dozens of contemporary masters' works as the Wenxuan lou congshu.

units.zh: 自著曰揅經室集。
units.en: His own collected works are titled the Yangjing shi ji.
units.literal: His own collected works are titled the Yangjing shi ji.

units.zh: 他紀事、談藝諸編，並為世重。
units.en: His other chronicles, art criticism, and compilations were also highly prized.
units.literal: His other records, art criticism, and compilations were also highly valued by the age.

units.zh: 身歷乾、嘉文物鼎盛之時，主持風會數十年，海內學者奉為山斗焉。
units.en: He lived through the Qianlong-Jiaqing flowering of culture, led scholarly fashion for decades, and scholars nationwide revered him as a towering figure.
units.literal: He lived through the Qianlong and Jiaqing age when culture flourished, presided over scholarly fashion for decades, and scholars throughout the realm revered him as a mountain peak.

units.zh: 汪廷珍，字瑟庵，江蘇山陽人。
units.en: Wang Tingzhen, courtesy name Se'an, came from Shanyang in Jiangsu.
units.literal: Wang Tingzhen, styled Se'an, was a native of Shanyang in Jiangsu.

units.zh: 少孤，母程撫之成立。
units.en: Orphaned young, he was raised to maturity by his mother Cheng.
units.literal: Orphaned young, his mother Cheng raised him to maturity.

units.zh: 家中落，歲兇，饘粥或不給，不令人知。
units.en: The family fell on hard times; in famine years they sometimes lacked even thin gruel, yet he let no one know.
units.literal: The family declined; in famine years thin gruel was sometimes not enough, yet he let no one know.

units.zh: 母曰：「吾非恥貧，恥言貧，疑有求於人也。」
units.en: His mother said, "I am not ashamed to be poor; I am ashamed to speak of poverty, as if we had something to ask of others."
units.literal: His mother said: "I am not ashamed of poverty; I am ashamed of speaking of poverty, as though we had something to ask of others."

units.zh: 力學，困諸生十年，始舉於鄉。
units.en: He studied hard; after ten years as a licentiate he finally passed the provincial exam.
units.literal: He studied diligently; after ten years as a licentiate he finally passed the provincial examination.

units.zh: 成乾隆五十四年一甲二名進士，授編修。
units.en: In Qianlong 54 he placed second in the first rank of jinshi and was appointed compiler.
units.literal: In the fifty-fourth year of Qianlong he placed second in the first rank of jinshi and was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 大考，擢侍讀。
units.en: In the palace examination he was promoted to reader.
units.literal: In the great examination he was promoted to reader.

units.zh: 未幾，遷祭酒。
units.en: Soon he was transferred to chancellor of the National University.
units.literal: Before long he was transferred to chancellor of the National University.

units.zh: 六十年，以事忤旨，降侍講。
units.en: In year 60 he offended the throne on a matter and was demoted to expositor.
units.literal: In the sixtieth year he offended the throne on a matter and was demoted to expositor.

units.zh: 嘉慶元年，直上書房。
units.en: In Jiaqing 1 he served in the Upper Study.
units.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he served in the Upper Study.

units.zh: 大考，擢侍講學士。
units.en: In the palace examination he was promoted to expositor of the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: In the great examination he was promoted to expositor of the Hanlin Academy.

units.zh: 母憂歸，服闋，補原官。
units.en: When mourning for his mother ended, he resumed his former post.
units.literal: When mourning for his mother ended, he resumed his former post.

units.zh: 七年，督安徽學政。
units.en: In year 7 he served as educational commissioner of Anhui.
units.literal: In the seventh year he supervised education in Anhui.

units.zh: 任滿，复督江西學政。
units.en: When his term ended he again served as Jiangxi educational commissioner.
units.literal: When his term ended he again supervised education in Jiangxi.

units.zh: 累遷侍讀學士、太僕寺卿、內閣學士，皆留任。
units.en: He rose in succession to Hanlin reader academician, minister of the Imperial Stud, and academician of the Grand Secretariat, while retaining his educational post.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to reader academician of the Hanlin Academy, minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and academician of the Grand Secretariat, retaining his educational post throughout.

units.zh: 廷珍學有根底，初為祭酒，以師道自居，選成均課士錄，教學者立言以義法，力戒摹擬剽竊之習。
units.en: Tingzhen had deep learning; as chancellor of the National University he held himself to the teacher's role, compiled lecture records, taught students to write by sound principles of meaning and form, and strictly forbade imitation and plagiarism.
units.literal: Tingzhen had solid learning; when he first became chancellor of the National University he took the teacher's role upon himself, selected records of lectures at the Imperial College, taught students to write according to principles of meaning and method, and strongly warned against imitation and plagiarism.

units.zh: 及官學政，為學約五則以訓士：曰辨塗，曰端本，曰敬業，曰裁偽，曰自立。
units.en: As educational commissioner he issued five rules for students: discern the right path, rectify fundamentals, honor one's studies, reject falsity, and maintain independence.
units.literal: When he became educational commissioner he drew up five rules of study to instruct scholars: discern the path, rectify the root, revere the profession, cut out falsity, and stand on one's own.

units.zh: 與士語，諄諄如父兄之於子弟。
units.en: In advising scholars he was earnest and kindly, like a father or elder brother with his sons.
units.literal: In speaking with scholars he was earnest and kindly, like a father or elder brother with sons and younger brothers.

units.zh: 所刻試牘，取易修辭之旨曰立誠編。
units.en: He published examination essays under the title Licheng bian, taking the Changes' teaching on sincere expression.
units.literal: In published examination essays he took the Yi Zhuan's teaching on sincere expression and titled the collection the Licheng bian.

units.zh: 士風為之一變。
units.en: Scholarly manners were transformed.
units.literal: Scholarly custom was thereby transformed.

units.zh: 萬載棚民入籍，舊分學額，後裁之，土客訐訟久不決；
units.en: Shed-dwellers of Wanzai had been registered and once had a separate degree quota; when it was later cut, natives and newcomers litigated for years without resolution;
units.literal: Shed people of Wanzai had entered the registers and formerly had a separate quota of degrees; later it was cut; native and guest communities sued and disputed for a long time without resolution;

units.zh: 廷珍請復分額，爭端乃息。
units.en: Tingzhen asked to restore the separate quota, and the dispute ended.
units.literal: Tingzhen memorialized to restore the separate quota, and the dispute then ceased.

units.zh: 十六年，授禮部侍郎。
units.en: In year 16 he was appointed vice-minister of Rites.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year he was appointed vice-minister of Rites.

units.zh: 复直上書房，侍宣宗學。
units.en: He again entered the Upper Study to instruct the future Xuanzong Emperor.
units.literal: He again entered the Upper Study and attended the Xuanzong Emperor in his studies.

units.zh: 十八年，典浙江鄉試，留學政，任滿回京。
units.en: In year 18 he presided over the Zhejiang provincial exams, stayed on as educational commissioner, and returned to the capital when his term ended.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year he presided over the Zhejiang provincial examination, remained as educational commissioner, and when his term ended returned to the capital.

units.zh: 二十二年，署翰林院掌院學士，擢左都御史，充上書房總師傅。
units.en: In year 22 he acted as Hanlin chancellor, was promoted to left censor-in-chief, and made chief tutor of the Upper Study.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year he acted as chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, was promoted to left censor-in-chief, and appointed chief tutor of the Upper Study.

units.zh: 二十三年，遷禮部尚書。
units.en: In year 23 he was transferred to minister of Rites.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year he was transferred to minister of Rites.

units.zh: 二十四年，仁宗六旬萬壽，慶賀期內遇孝慈高皇后忌辰，部臣未援故事疏請服色，坐率忽，降侍郎。
units.en: In year 24, during the Renzong Emperor's sixtieth birthday celebrations, Empress Xiaocigao's death anniversary fell within the congratulatory period; ministry officials failed to cite precedent on mourning dress; he was punished for negligence and demoted to vice-minister.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, during celebrations for the Renzong Emperor's sixtieth birthday, the anniversary of Empress Xiaocigao's death fell within the congratulatory period; the ministry officials did not cite precedent in memorializing on dress colors; he was punished for negligence and demoted to vice-minister.

units.zh: 逾年，复授禮部尚書。
units.en: After more than a year he was again appointed minister of Rites.
units.literal: After more than a year he was again appointed minister of Rites.

units.zh: 道光二年，典會試，教習庶吉士。
units.en: In Daoguang 2 he presided over the metropolitan exams and instructed Hanlin bachelors.
units.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he presided over the metropolitan examination and instructed the bachelors of the Hanlin Academy.

units.zh: 車駕謁陵，命留京辦事。
units.en: When the emperor visited the tombs he was ordered to remain in the capital to handle affairs.
units.literal: When the imperial carriage visited the tombs he was ordered to remain in the capital to handle affairs.

units.zh: 三年，宣宗釋奠文廟禮成，臨幸辟雍，詔曰：「禮部尚書汪廷珍蒙皇考簡用上書房師傅，與朕朝夕講論，非法不道，使朕通經義，辨邪正，受益良多。
units.en: In year 3, after the Confucian sacrifice and the emperor's visit to the Imperial College, an edict said: "Minister of Rites Wang Tingzhen was chosen by my late father as Upper Study tutor; he discussed the classics with me daily, spoke only what was lawful, helped me master the classics and distinguish right from wrong, and benefited me greatly.
units.literal: In the third year, when the Xuanzong Emperor completed the Confucian sacrifice and visited the Imperial College, an edict said: "Minister of Rites Wang Tingzhen was selected by my late father as tutor in the Upper Study; he discussed the classics with me morning and evening, would speak nothing contrary to the law, enabled me to master the classics and distinguish right from wrong, and benefited me greatly.

units.zh: 朕親政後，畀以尚書之任，盡心厥職，於師道、臣道可謂兼備。
units.en: After I took the throne I gave him ministerial office and he devoted himself to duty; in both teacher's and minister's roles he fulfilled his charge.
units.literal: After I personally took power I entrusted him with the ministry and he devoted himself to duty; in teacher's duty and minister's duty he may be said to have fulfilled both.

units.zh: 今值臨雍，眷懷舊學，加太子太保。
units.en: On this visit to the College, cherishing old studies, I grant him senior guardian of the heir apparent.
units.literal: Now, on this visit to the College, cherishing old studies, I add the rank of senior guardian of the heir apparent.

units.zh: 子報原，以員外郎即補用，示崇儒重道之意。」
units.en: His son Baoyuan is appointed directly as vice director of a bureau, showing honor for Confucian learning."
units.literal: His son Baoyuan is appointed directly to the post of vice director of a bureau, showing the intent to honor Confucian learning and the Way."

units.zh: 四年，仁宗實錄成，賜子報閏主事，孫承佑舉人。
units.en: In year 4, when the Veritable Records of Renzong were completed, his son Baoyuan was made junior director of a bureau and his grandson Chengyou was granted licentiate status.
units.literal: In the fourth year, when the Veritable Records of Renzong were completed, his son Baoyuan was given the rank of junior director of a bureau and his grandson Chengyou was granted licentiate status.

units.zh: 南河高堰潰決阻運，上以廷珍生長淮、揚，命偕尚書文孚往勘，劾河督張文浩、總督孫玉庭，譴黜有差。
units.en: The Gaoyan embankment on the Southern Canal burst and blocked transport; as Tingzhen had grown up in the Huai-Yang region, the emperor sent him with Minister Wen Fu to inspect; they impeached canal director Zhang Wenhao and Governor Sun Yuting, who were punished accordingly.
units.literal: The Gaoyan embankment on the Southern Canal burst and blocked transport; because Tingzhen had grown up in the Huai-Yang region, the emperor ordered him together with Minister Wen Fu to inspect; they impeached canal director Zhang Wenhao and Governor Sun Yuting, who were punished in varying degrees.

units.zh: 疏籌修濬事宜，交河督辦理。
units.en: He memorialized dredging and repair plans for the canal director to carry out.
units.literal: He memorialized plans for dredging and repair and handed them to the canal director for implementation.

units.zh: 五年，回京，協辦大學士。
units.en: In year 5 he returned to the capital and was made assistant grand secretary.
units.literal: In the fifth year he returned to the capital and was made assistant grand secretary.

units.zh: 七年，卒，上震悼，優詔賜卹，贈太子太師，入祀賢良祠，命大阿哥賜奠，賜銀千兩治喪，諡文端。
units.en: In year 7 he died; the emperor grieved deeply, granted favorable rites, posthumously made him grand tutor of the heir apparent, enshrined him in the Shrine of Worthy Ministers, ordered the eldest imperial son to offer sacrifice, granted a thousand taels for the funeral, and gave the posthumous title Wenduan.
units.literal: In the seventh year he died; the emperor was deeply grieved, granted favorable posthumous rites, posthumously made him grand tutor of the heir apparent, entered him in the Shrine of Worthy Ministers, ordered the eldest imperial son to offer sacrifice, granted a thousand taels of silver for the funeral, and gave the posthumous title Wenduan.

units.zh: 江蘇請祀鄉賢，特詔允之。
units.en: Jiangsu requested his enshrinement among local worthies, and a special edict approved.
units.literal: Jiangsu requested his enshrinement among local worthies, and a special edict approved it.

units.zh: 廷珍風裁嚴峻，立朝無所親附。
units.en: Tingzhen was stern in bearing and joined no faction at court.
units.literal: Tingzhen's bearing was stern; in court he attached himself to no faction.

units.zh: 出入內廷，寮寀見之，莫不肅然。
units.en: In the inner court colleagues who met him were invariably awed into respect.
units.literal: Entering and leaving the inner court, colleagues who saw him were invariably awed into respect.

units.zh: 自言生平力戒刻薄，凡貪冒諂諛有不忍為，皆守母教。
units.en: He said he strove all his life against harshness; whatever greed, corruption, or flattery he could not bear to do, he avoided by his mother's teaching.
units.literal: He said himself that throughout life he strove against harshness; whatever greed, corruption, flattery, or sycophancy he could not bear to do, he refrained from by his mother's teaching.

units.zh: 大學士阮元服其多聞淵博，勸著書，廷珍曰：「六經之奧，昔人先我言之，便何以長語相溷？
units.en: Grand Secretary Ruan Yuan admired his learning and urged him to write; Tingzhen said: "The depths of the Six Classics were spoken of first by others — why should I add long talk to muddy them?
units.literal: Grand Secretary Ruan Yuan admired his wide learning and urged him to write books; Tingzhen said: "The profundities of the Six Classics have already been spoken of by earlier men — with what long talk would I muddy them?

units.zh: 讀書所以析義，要歸於中有所主而已。」
units.en: Reading is to analyze meaning; what matters is a settled conviction within."
units.literal: The purpose of reading is to analyze meaning; what matters is to have a settled conviction within."

units.zh: 服用樸儉，或以公孫弘擬之，笑曰：「大丈夫不以曲學阿世為恥，而徒畏布被之譏乎？」
units.en: He dressed plainly; when compared to Gongsun Hong he laughed: "Should a true man fear crooked learning and fawning on the world, yet only dread ridicule for a cotton quilt?"
units.literal: His dress and conduct were plain and frugal; when some compared him to Gongsun Hong he laughed and said: "Should a true man be ashamed of crooked learning and fawning on the age, yet only fear the ridicule of a cotton quilt?"

units.zh: 後進以文謁，言不宗道，曰：「異日恐喪所守。」
units.en: When juniors presented writings that did not honor the Way, he said: "Some day you may lose what you should uphold."
units.literal: When juniors presented literary works whose words did not honor the Way, he said: "Some day you may lose what you should uphold."

units.zh: 屬官有例送御史者，持不可，曰：「斯人華而不實，何以立朝？」
units.en: A subordinate wished to recommend someone for censor; he refused: "This man is showy without substance — how can he serve at court?"
units.literal: A subordinate had someone customarily recommended for censor; he refused, saying: "This man is showy without substance — how can he stand at court?"

units.zh: 後皆如所言，人服其精鑑。
units.en: Later events proved him right, and people admired his judgment.
units.literal: Later events proved as he said, and people admired his keen judgment.

units.zh: 湯金釗，字敦甫，浙江蕭山人。
units.en: Tang Jinzhao, courtesy name Dunfu, came from Xiaoshan in Zhejiang.
units.literal: Tang Jinzhao, styled Dunfu, was a native of Xiaoshan in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 嘉慶四年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。
units.en: In Jiaqing 4 he became a jinshi, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he passed the jinshi examination, was selected a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 十三年，入直上書房。
units.en: In year 13 he entered the Upper Study.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he entered the Upper Study.

units.zh: 金釗端謹自持，宣宗在潛邸，甚敬禮之。
units.en: Jinzhao was upright and self-restrained; when the future Xuanzong Emperor was still heir apparent he treated him with great respect.
units.literal: Jinzhao was upright and self-restrained; when the Xuanzong Emperor was still heir apparent he treated him with great respect.

units.zh: 母憂服闋，擢侍講，督湖南學政。
units.en: When mourning ended he was promoted to expositor and served as Hunan educational commissioner.
units.literal: When mourning for his mother ended he was promoted to expositor and supervised education in Hunan.

units.zh: 累遷內閣學士。
units.en: He was promoted in succession to academician of the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to academician of the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 二十一年，复直上書房。
units.en: In year 21 he again entered the Upper Study.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year he again entered the Upper Study.

units.zh: 典江南鄉試，留學政，詔勉以訓士不患無才，務培德，經學為本，才藻次之。
units.en: He presided over the Jiangnan provincial exams and stayed as educational commissioner; an edict urged him to teach scholars not to fear lack of talent but to cultivate virtue, ground students in classical learning, and rank literary ornament second.
units.literal: He presided over the Jiangnan provincial examination, remained as educational commissioner, and an edict exhorted him to instruct scholars not to worry that talent was lacking but to cultivate virtue, take classical learning as foundation, and place literary ornament second.

units.zh: 金釗闡揚詔旨，通誡士子。
units.en: Jinzhao expounded the edict and widely admonished scholars.
units.literal: Jinzhao expounded the edict and widely admonished the scholars.

units.zh: 會匪以禍福煽惑鄉愚，金釗著福善辨，刊發曉諭。
units.en: Secret societies used fortune and misfortune to delude villagers; Jinzhao wrote the Fushan bian and published it to enlighten them.
units.literal: Secret societies used fortune and misfortune to delude country folk; Jinzhao wrote the Fushan bian and published it to enlighten them.

units.zh: 徐州俗悍，武生不馴者，繩之以法。
units.en: Xuzhou customs were fierce; unruly martial licentiates he restrained by law.
units.literal: Xuzhou customs were fierce; martial licentiates who were unruly he restrained by law.

units.zh: 遷禮部侍郎，任滿，仍直上書房。
units.en: He was transferred to vice-minister of Rites; when his term ended he again served in the Upper Study.
units.literal: He was transferred to vice-minister of Rites; when his term ended he again served in the Upper Study.

units.zh: 宣宗即位，調吏部，益鄉用。
units.en: When Xuanzong succeeded he was moved to the Ministry of Personnel and increasingly entrusted with important duties.
units.literal: When the Xuanzong Emperor succeeded to the throne he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and was increasingly put to important use.

units.zh: 時用尚書英和議，命各省查州縣陋規，明定限制。
units.en: Following Minister Ying He's proposal, the throne ordered each province to investigate irregular local levies and set clear limits.
units.literal: At that time, following Minister Ying He's proposal, the throne ordered each province to investigate irregular local levies at the district and prefectural level and fix clear limits.

units.zh: 金釗疏言：「陋規皆出於民，地方官未敢公然苛索者，畏上知之治其罪也。
units.en: Jinzhao memorialized: "Irregular levies all come from the people; local officials dare not extort openly only because they fear punishment if the throne learns of it.
units.literal: Jinzhao memorialized: "Irregular levies all come from the people; local officials dare not openly extort only because they fear the throne will learn of it and punish them.

units.zh: 今若明定章程，即為例所應得，勢必明目張膽，求多於例外，雖有嚴旨，不能禁矣。
units.en: If limits are now fixed in writing, they become what officials may take by precedent; they will openly demand more beyond the rule; even stern edicts cannot stop it.
units.literal: If regulations are now fixed in writing, they become what precedent allows; officials will surely demand more beyond the rule in broad daylight; even with stern edicts this cannot be forbidden.

units.zh: 況名目碎雜，所在不同，檢察難得真確，轉滋紛擾。
units.en: Moreover the items are numerous, scattered, and differ by place; investigation can hardly be accurate and will only increase disorder.
units.literal: Moreover the items are numerous and scattered and differ from place to place; investigation can hardly be accurate and will only increase disorder.

units.zh: 無論不當明定章程，亦不能妥立章程也。
units.en: Regulations should not be fixed in writing — nor can sound regulations really be established.
units.literal: Not only should regulations not be fixed in writing — sound regulations cannot be established at all.

units.zh: 吏治貴在得人，​​得其人，雖取於民而民愛戴之，不害其為清；
units.en: Good government depends on the right men; with the right man, even taking from the people they love him and he remains clean;
units.literal: Good government depends on getting the right men; with the right man, even if he takes from the people they love and support him, and he is not harmed in being called clean;

units.zh: 非其人，雖不取於民而民嫉仇之，何論其為清？
units.en: with the wrong man, even taking nothing they hate him — what talk of cleanliness?
units.literal: with the wrong man, even if he takes nothing from the people they hate and resent him — what talk is there of his being clean?

units.zh: 有治人無治法，惟在督撫舉措公明，而非立法所能限制。」
units.en: There is government by men, not by laws; it depends on governors acting fairly, not on legislation."
units.literal: There is government by men, not government by laws; it depends on governors-general and governors acting fairly, not on what legislation can restrict."

units.zh: 會中外大臣亦多言其不便，金釗疏入，上手批答曰：「朝有諍臣，使朕胸中黑白分明，無傷於政體，不勝欣悅！」
units.en: Ministers at court and provinces also said it was impracticable; when Jinzhao's memorial arrived the emperor endorsed it: "The court has remonstrating ministers, so black and white are clear in my mind without harm to government — I am exceedingly pleased!"
units.literal: At the same time ministers at court and in the provinces also said it was impracticable; when Jinzhao's memorial arrived the emperor personally endorsed it: "The court has remonstrating ministers, so that black and white are clear in my breast without harm to government — I am exceedingly pleased!"

units.zh: 予議敘。
units.en: He was granted merit promotion.
units.literal: He was granted merit promotion.

units.zh: 道光元年，兼署戶部侍郎。
units.en: In Daoguang 1 he also acted as vice-minister of Revenue.
units.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he also acted as vice-minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 兩江總督孫玉庭以南漕浮收不能盡去，議請八折徵收，學政姚文田、御史王家相皆奏言不可。
units.en: Governor-General Sun Yuting of the Two Jiangs, because surplus collection on southern tribute grain could not be wholly stopped, proposed an eighty-percent levy; Educational Commissioner Yao Wentian and Censor Wang Jiaxiang both said it must not be done.
units.literal: Governor-General Sun Yuting of the Two Jiangs, because surplus collection on southern tribute grain could not be wholly eliminated, proposed collecting at eighty percent; Educational Commissioner Yao Wentian and Censor Wang Jiaxiang both memorialized that this could not be done.

units.zh: 金釗既同部臣議覆，复疏爭曰：「康熙中奉永不加賦之明詔，此大清億萬年培養國脈之至計也。
units.en: Jinzhao had joined the ministry reply but memorialized again: "In Kangxi's reign the edict declared the land tax would never increase — this is the supreme plan by which the Great Qing nourishes the nation's lifeblood for ten thousand years.
units.literal: Jinzhao had joined the ministry in drafting the reply, but again memorialized in protest: "In the Kangxi reign the clear edict was issued that the land tax would never be increased — this is the supreme plan by which the Great Qing nourishes the nation's lifeblood for ten thousand years.

units.zh: 前有議加耗米及公費銀者，戶部以事近加賦議駁。
units.en: Earlier proposals to add surcharge grain and public-fee silver were rejected by Revenue as tantamount to increasing the tax.
units.literal: Earlier proposals to add surcharge grain and public-fee silver were rejected by the Ministry of Revenue as tantamount to increasing the tax.

units.zh: 今准其略有浮收，不肖者益無顧忌，而浮收且多於往日，雖告以收逾八折即予嚴參，然前此逾額者何嘗不干嚴譴，卒不聞為之減少，獨於新定之額，恪遵而不敢逾，此臣之所不敢信也。
units.en: Now to allow some surplus collection, the unscrupulous will grow bolder and collection will exceed former days; though told that collection beyond eighty percent brings severe impeachment, those who exceeded quotas in the past were often punished yet collection never decreased — that they will scrupulously keep the new quota is what I cannot believe.
units.literal: Now to allow some surplus collection, the unscrupulous will be all the more reckless, and surplus collection will exceed former days; though told that collection beyond eighty percent will bring severe impeachment, in the past those who exceeded quotas were often severely punished yet collection was never heard to decrease — that they will scrupulously observe the new quota and not dare exceed it is what this minister cannot believe.

units.zh: 在督撫奏定之後，不慮控告浮收；
units.en: After governors fix the rate, they will not fear accusations of surplus collection;
units.literal: After governors-general and governors have fixed the rate, they will not fear accusations of surplus collection;

units.zh: 在州縣縱有發覺，又將巧脫其罪。
units.en: if district officials are caught, they will cleverly escape punishment.
units.literal: if district and prefectural officials are discovered, they will cleverly escape guilt.

units.zh: 是限制仍同虛設，徒為盛朝開加賦之端，臣竊惜之！」
units.en: Limits will be empty, opening a door to increased taxation for this glorious dynasty — I deeply regret it!"
units.literal: Limits will remain a dead letter, opening only a door to increased taxation for this glorious dynasty — your servant deeply regrets it!"

units.zh: 疏入，下江、浙督撫妥議，事乃寢。
units.en: The memorial was sent to Jiangsu and Zhejiang governors for discussion, and the matter was dropped.
units.literal: When the memorial arrived it was sent to the Jiangsu and Zhejiang governors-general for proper discussion, and the matter was dropped.

units.zh: 尋以吏部事繁，罷直上書房。
units.en: Soon, as Personnel affairs were heavy, he left the Upper Study.
units.literal: Soon, because the Ministry of Personnel was busy, he left the Upper Study.

units.zh: 典江南鄉試，道經銅山，見運河支渠為黃流淤塞，歲苦潦，回京奏請疏濬，如議行。
units.en: Presiding over the Jiangnan provincial exams, he passed Tongshan and saw canal branches choked by Yellow River silt and yearly flooding; back in the capital he memorialized for dredging, and it was done.
units.literal: Presiding over the Jiangnan provincial examination, he passed through Tongshan and saw canal branches choked by Yellow River silt, with yearly flooding; returning to the capital he memorialized for dredging, and it was carried out as proposed.

units.zh: 二年，典會試，調戶部，父憂歸。
units.en: In year 2 he presided over the metropolitan exams, was moved to Revenue, and returned home on mourning for his father.
units.literal: In the second year he presided over the metropolitan examination, was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, and returned home on mourning for his father.

units.zh: 六年，服闋，署禮、工二部及倉場侍郎，仍直上書房，授皇長子奕緯讀。
units.en: In year 6, when mourning ended, he acted as vice-minister of Rites and Works and of granary stores, again served in the Upper Study, and instructed the eldest imperial son Yiwei.
units.literal: In the sixth year, when mourning ended, he acted as vice-minister of Rites and Works and of the granary stores, again served in the Upper Study, and instructed the eldest imperial son Yiwei.

units.zh: 實授戶部侍郎。
units.en: He received substantive appointment as vice-minister of Revenue.
units.literal: He received substantive appointment as vice-minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 七年，連擢左都御史、禮部尚書、上方倚畀，迭命赴山西、直隸、四川、湖北、福建鞫獄按事，四年之中，凡奉使五次。
units.en: In year 7 he was promoted in succession to left censor-in-chief and minister of Rites; the emperor relied on him and sent him five times in four years to Shanxi, Zhili, Sichuan, Hubei, and Fujian to try cases.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was successively promoted to left censor-in-chief and minister of Rites; the emperor relied on him; he was repeatedly ordered to Shanxi, Zhili, Sichuan, Hubei, and Fujian to try cases and conduct investigations — five missions in four years.

units.zh: 所至持法明慎，悉當上意。
units.en: Wherever he went he applied the law clearly and cautiously and fully met the emperor's intent.
units.literal: Wherever he went he held the law clearly and cautiously and fully met the emperor's intent.

units.zh: 充上書房總師傅，調吏部尚書。
units.en: He was made chief tutor of the Upper Study and transferred to minister of Personnel.
units.literal: He was appointed chief tutor of the Upper Study and transferred to minister of the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 十一年，皇長子遘疾不起，忌者因以激上怒，罷總師傅，降兵部侍郎。
units.en: In year 11 the eldest imperial son fell ill and died; enemies stirred the emperor's anger; Jinzhao was removed as chief tutor and demoted to vice-minister of War.
units.literal: In the eleventh year the eldest imperial son fell ill and died; enemies used this to stir the emperor's anger; Jinzhao was removed as chief tutor and demoted to vice-minister of War.

units.zh: 逾兩年，復自左都御史授工部尚書，轉吏部。
units.en: After more than two years he was again promoted from left censor-in-chief to minister of Works and then to Personnel.
units.literal: After more than two years he was again promoted from left censor-in-chief to minister of Works and then transferred to Personnel.

units.zh: 連典江南、順天鄉試。
units.en: He presided in succession over the Jiangnan and Shuntian provincial exams.
units.literal: He successively presided over the Jiangnan and Shuntian provincial examinations.

units.zh: 十六年，陝西巡撫楊名颺被劾，命偕侍郎文慶往按，暫署巡撫；
units.en: In year 16 Shaanxi Governor Yang Mingyang was impeached; Jinzhao was sent with Vice Minister Wen Qing to investigate and temporarily acted as governor;
units.literal: In the sixteenth year Shaanxi Governor Yang Mingyang was impeached; Jinzhao was ordered to go with Vice Minister Wen Qing to investigate and temporarily acted as governor;

units.zh: 又往四川按事，名颺復與臬司互訐，得其冒工庇屬狀，劾罷。
units.en: he went again to Sichuan; Mingyang quarreled again with the provincial judge; Jinzhao proved he had falsely claimed work and shielded subordinates and impeached him into dismissal.
units.literal: he again went to Sichuan on an investigation; Mingyang again quarreled with the provincial judge; Jinzhao obtained proof that he had falsely claimed work and shielded subordinates and impeached him, leading to dismissal.

units.zh: 會京察，以奉使公明，予議敘。
units.en: At the capital personnel review he received merit promotion for fair conduct on his missions.
units.literal: At the capital personnel review he was granted merit promotion for fair conduct on his missions.

units.zh: 又赴張家口、太原鞫獄。
units.en: He again went to Zhangjiakou and Taiyuan to try cases.
units.literal: He again went to Zhangjiakou and Taiyuan to try cases.

units.zh: 十八年，以戶部尚書協辦大學士，仍調吏部。
units.en: In year 18, as minister of Revenue he was made assistant grand secretary and again moved to Personnel.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year, as minister of Revenue he was made assistant grand secretary and again transferred to Personnel.

units.zh: 十九年，命按事安徽、江蘇、浙江。
units.en: In year 19 he was ordered to investigate affairs in Anhui, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year he was ordered to conduct investigations in Anhui, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang.

units.zh: 自禁煙議起，海疆久不靖。
units.en: Since the opium prohibition debate, the maritime frontier had long been unsettled.
units.literal: From the time the opium prohibition was debated, the maritime frontier had long been unsettled.

units.zh: 林則徐既罷，琦善主撫，復不得要領。
units.en: Lin Zexu had been dismissed; Qishan favored appeasement yet again failed to grasp essentials.
units.literal: Lin Zexu had already been dismissed; Qishan favored appeasement yet again failed to grasp essentials.

units.zh: 金釗素不附和議，與穆彰阿等意齟《齒吾》。
units.en: Jinzhao had never favored appeasement and was at odds with Muzhanga and others.
units.literal: Jinzhao had never favored the appeasement faction and was at odds with Muzhanga and others.

units.zh: 一日召對，上從容問廣東事可付諸何人，金釗以林則徐對，上不悅。
units.en: One day at audience the emperor casually asked whom Guangdong affairs could be entrusted to; Jinzhao named Lin Zexu; the emperor was displeased.
units.literal: One day at audience the emperor casually asked to whom Guangdong affairs could be entrusted; Jinzhao answered Lin Zexu; the emperor was displeased.

units.zh: 至二十一年，事且益棘，詔予則徐四品卿銜赴浙江軍營，亦未果用之。
units.en: By year 21 affairs grew urgent; an edict gave Lin Zexu fourth-rank vice-minister rank and sent him to the Zhejiang army, yet he was still not effectively used.
units.literal: By the twenty-first year affairs grew more urgent; an edict gave Lin Zexu fourth-rank vice-minister rank and sent him to the Zhejiang army camp, yet he was still not effectively used.

units.zh: 未幾，有吏部司員陳起詩規避倉差，金釗還其呈牘禁勿遞，為所訐，坐降四級調用。
units.en: Soon a Personnel clerk, Chen Qishi, tried to evade granary duty; Jinzhao returned his petition and forbade submission; Chen impeached him and he was demoted four ranks and transferred.
units.literal: Before long a Personnel bureau clerk, Chen Qishi, tried to evade granary duty; Jinzhao returned his petition and forbade its submission; Chen impeached him, and he was punished by demotion four ranks and transfer.

units.zh: 逾年，授光祿寺卿。
units.en: After more than a year he was appointed minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
units.literal: After more than a year he was appointed minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

units.zh: 以衰老乞罷，住京養疴，許以二品頂戴致仕。
units.en: He asked to retire for age and illness, stayed in the capital to nurse his health, and was permitted to retire with second-rank button.
units.literal: He asked to retire on account of age and infirmity, remained in the capital to nurse his illness, and was permitted to retire with second-rank button.

units.zh: 久之，上仍眷念，二十九年，皇太后之喪，具疏上慰，賜頭品頂戴。
units.en: Long afterward the emperor still cherished him; in year 29, at the empress dowager's mourning, he submitted a memorial of condolence and was granted the first-rank button.
units.literal: After a long time the emperor still cherished him; in the twenty-ninth year, at the empress dowager's mourning, he submitted a memorial of condolence and was granted the first-rank button.

units.zh: 咸豐四年，重宴鹿鳴，加太子太保。
units.en: In Xianfeng 4 he again attended the deer-ming banquet and was made senior guardian of the heir apparent.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Xianfeng he again attended the deer-ming banquet and was made senior guardian of the heir apparent.

units.zh: 六年，卒，詔以尚書例賜卹，諡文端。
units.en: In year 6 he died; an edict granted ministerial posthumous rites, with posthumous title Wenduan.
units.literal: In the sixth year he died; an edict granted posthumous rites according to the ministerial standard, with posthumous title Wenduan.

units.zh: 金釗自為翰林，布衣脫粟，後常不改。
units.en: From his Hanlin days Jinzhao wore plain cloth and ate simple grain, and seldom changed afterward.
units.literal: From his days as a Hanlin scholar Jinzhao wore plain cloth and ate simple grain, and afterward he seldom changed.

units.zh: 當官廉察，負一時清望，雖被排擠，卒以恩禮終。
units.en: In office he was incorrupt and bore the age's reputation for integrity; though pushed aside, he ended with imperial favor.
units.literal: In office he was incorrupt and observant and bore the pure reputation of the age; though squeezed out, he ended with imperial favor and ritual.

units.zh: 子修，通政司副使。
units.en: His son Xiu was vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission.
units.literal: His son Xiu was vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission.

units.zh: 論曰：阮元由詞臣出膺疆寄，竟殄海寇；
units.en: The historian comments: Ruan Yuan rose from the literary service to frontier command and at last destroyed the sea pirates;
units.literal: The historian comments: Ruan Yuan, rising from a literary official to bear frontier commission, finally exterminated sea bandits;

units.zh: 開府粵、滇，綏邊之績，並有足稱；
units.en: he governed Guangdong and Yunnan, and his border-pacification achievements are likewise praiseworthy;
units.literal: he governed Guangdong and Yunnan, and his achievements in pacifying the borders are also worthy of praise;

units.zh: 晚登宰輔，與樞臣曹振鏞異趣，惟以文學裁成後進，世推耆碩。
units.en: late in life he reached the chief counselors; he differed in outlook from Grand Councilor Cao Zhenyong, yet shaped the young through literary learning alone, and the age hailed him as a venerable master.
units.literal: late he ascended to chief counselor; he differed in orientation from Grand Councilor Cao Zhenyong, but only shaped later generations through literary learning — the age acclaimed him as an elder master.

units.zh: 汪廷珍、湯金釗正色立朝，清節並著；
units.en: Wang Tingzhen and Tang Jinzhao stood with stern integrity at court, their spotless conduct equally renowned;
units.literal: Wang Tingzhen and Tang Jinzhao stood with stern countenance at court, their pure integrity equally renowned;

units.zh: 金釗雖以直言被擯，宣宗終鑑其忠誠，易名曰「端」，胥無愧焉。
units.en: though Jinzhao was cast out for blunt counsel, the Xuanzong Emperor ultimately recognized his loyalty and gave him the posthumous character "Duan" — none of them fell short of honor.
units.literal: though Jinzhao was pushed aside for outspoken counsel, the Xuanzong Emperor ultimately recognized his loyalty and gave him the posthumous character "Duan" — none of them fell short of honor.
